Dear Jeff,
I am sending the additional information on Rutherford Consulting as you requested. I'm the assistant to Mark Kearns, VP at Rutherford Consulting. He lives in Houston. When Mark is in town, I set up short 30 min meetings for him with companies and senior management, CEOs, presidents and so on. In these meetings Mark will talk about industry info and tell them more about Rutherford Consulting.
Attached, please review "Overview Presentation.ppt". Once you've had a chance to check out the materials, I'll call to find a time that works for both you and Mark.
Thanks for your time.
Best regards,
Michael M. Munn
Executive Assistant - Rutherford Consulting
